problem: The initial extra-post fixture used rr:idiomaDetectado as Literal('en', datatype=xsd:string). The declared sh:in list in rr-shapes.ttl uses the plain literal 'en', so pySHACL reported an InConstraintComponent violation unrelated to the intended extra-valid-RDF-post fault.
correction: The rerun changed the injected extra post to copy the plain literal form Literal('en'), leaving shapes unchanged.
evidence_limit: The initial logs were overwritten when the single-case rerun regenerated this case directory. This note records the cause and correction, but the preserved executable evidence for I3 is the corrected rerun now stored in this case directory.
final_interpretation: After correction, original SHACL and chain checks did not detect the extra valid RDF post; the RDF inventory diagnostic detected the extra rr:Post identifier.
